title: Homogeneous fraction compatibility for relative Proj twist transitions
statement: Given the chart isomorphisms and a normalized scalar-extension comparison for U ≤ V, with the chart square commuting and the chart preimages identified, the section-normalized transition map sends every homogeneous degree-one fraction a/1 on V to the fraction res(a)/1 on U.

proof.text: Specialize the given IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison predicate to j=i=1, k=0, denominator b=1, coefficient c=1, and the section twistChartFraction V a on the actual chart open. Every point is in D_+(1); val_unitToTwist_app_apply proves the source fraction equation. Pointwise subtype extensionality identifies the transported section with unitToTwist(res(a))(1) on the preimage open.

Use the section normalization from existsUnique_tensorPullbackSectionAdjunction to replace the adjunction unit by tensorPullbackSection. The composite in the conclusion is therefore the scalarExtensionTwistSection just computed, followed by equality transport. Equality induction on arbitrary chart opens proves that this transport carries unitToTwist(res(a))(1) to the same fraction on the identified target open.

theorem twist_chart_transition_fraction
    (L : A.relProj.Modules)
    (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjι U)).obj L ≅
        Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1)
    (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).obj
          (Proj.twist (A.grading V) j) ≅ Proj.twist (A.grading U) j)
    (hθ : Proj.IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison (A.res h)
      (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h)) θ)
    (hsq :
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).obj L)
        (A.relProjFunctor_map_relProjι (homOfLE h)).symm) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp
          (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h)) (A.relProjι V)).app L ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).mapIso
          (chart V) ≪≫ θ 1 = chart U)
    (hopen : A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h) ⁻¹ᵁ A.twistChartOpen V =
      A.twistChartOpen U) :
    ∀ a : A.grading V 1,
      let t : Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading V) 1, A.twistChartOpen V) →+
          Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, A.twistChartOpen U) :=
        ConcreteCategory.hom
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionAdjunction
              (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).unit.app
              (Proj.twist (A.grading V) 1)).app (A.twistChartOpen V) ≫
            (θ 1).hom.app
              (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h) ⁻¹ᵁ A.twistChartOpen V) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg
              (fun W ↦ Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, W)) hopen))
      t (A.twistChartFraction V a) =
        A.twistChartFraction U ⟨A.res h a, (A.res h).map_mem a.property⟩
